summary: Product Manager who ships agentic AI into security-critical government and enterprise systems. I own the roadmap for SPEED, Taiwan's market-leading official document system serving 400+ organizations, and have shipped an on-premise LLM agent with human-in-the-loop review and ML routing at 85–95% production accuracy. Seven years of full-stack engineering before product let me weigh model quality, hardware limits, and ISO 27001/27701 compliance directly with engineering teams. I still build, planning and prototyping with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Pi.

experience.title: Product Manager
highlights: Own the roadmap for SPEED, Taiwan's market-leading official document system serving 400+ government and enterprise organizations, deciding what ships and trading platform features against client-specific projects; annual product revenue more than doubled from 2022 to 2025.

Shipped an AI agent to production that drafts official letters and retrieves documents through RAG search on OpenSearch, running on on-premise LLMs including Gemma 4 with human-in-the-loop review; live at 4 clients, more in POC.

Designed the agent around reusable skills (instructions plus scripts and tools), and led a 9-person internal team that rolled out skill building and use on Open WebUI and OpenWork across a ~100-person business unit, developers and non-developers alike.

Shipped ML document routing at 85–95% production accuracy across client deployments, and launched an embeddable agent product (chat widget plus admin console) for systems outside SPEED, now live at its first customer.
Lead a 10+ person cross-functional team; now building an MCP server so the agent can plan and run multi-step workflows such as dispatching documents and tracing where one is stuck.

experience.title: Product Development Manager
highlights: Turned AI research prototypes into shippable features, aligning AI Research, Engineering, and Presales to embed LLM/NLP document generation in SPEED.
Directed VITAL-OD, the secure Azure SaaS edition with a free-trial-to-subscription model, opening NGOs, NPOs, and small agencies as a new segment with ~50 new subscribing organizations per year.

experience.title: Software Designer & System Analyst
highlights: Built the platform's first semantic search with OpenSearch and vector embeddings, and designed modular services using Domain-Driven Design.
Built DevSecOps pipelines (SAST/DAST/SCA) and delivered TW FidO digital signatures and document encryption for compliance.

experience.title: Software Engineer (Junior → Senior)
highlights: Built the browser-based WYSIWYG editor for regulation-compliant official documents, now the core editing experience for 400+ organizations and also sold standalone.
Shipped SPEED's first ML feature, a recommendation model, in 2019; full-stack delivery across .NET, SQL Server, TypeScript, and Kendo UI.

education.degree: Bachelor's degree, Plant Pathology and Microbiology

certifications.name: Model Context Protocol (Intro & Advanced), Claude Code in Action, Agent Skills, Subagents, AI Fluency courses
